messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager duty: High error rate on /gen endpoint (p99 latency 18s, 5xx spike). Trigger: 90% of requests failing. Escalation to oncall.

pagerduty-bot: oncall: sanjay (rotation: infra-weekend). Please acknowledge.

sanjay: ack. looking. pulling metrics and traces.

eli: i see a sharp bump starting at 09:12 UTC, aligns with deploy window at 09:10. p95 goes from 280ms -> 1.9s, p99 -> 18s. 504s from gateway + downstream timeouts.

marta: was there a canary? i deployed rollout v2026.3.10 at 09:09; canary 10% then 100% at 09:11. i didn't change routing. only feature flag: multiplex_http=true.

sanjay: good catch. checking gateway logs -> backend keepalive resets and connection pool exhaustion. stack traces show many connections stuck in CLOSE_WAIT.

frank: quick smoke: `curl -sv -X POST https://api.redwood/dev/gen -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns chunked response hang then 504. local logs: repeated `write: broken pipe` from proxy.

marta: hm — multiplex_http flips http client behavior to use connection reuse + long-lived streams. maybe it interacts badly with our gateway's max-conns setting. we didn't increase pool size.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/timeout-regression. Suggested mitigations: rollback, route to stable region, increase proxy pool.

sanjay: priority: rollback canary -> full rollback if it reduces errors. second: increase gateway max conn as temporary mitigation.

marta: initiating rollback now: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/gen-service --to-revision=2026-03-09-9`

deploy-bot: rollback started for deployment gen-service. watching health checks.

sanjay: switching traffic back to control plane variant: `routeshift set --service gen-service --version stable-20260308 --weight 100`

eli: metrics: errors falling within 90s of rollback. p99 down to 320ms at 09:14. 5xx rate back to baseline.

frank: confirming: no customer-visible 5xx now in us-west. some queued requests still in retry window.

cs-lead: CS: we have two customers who reported timeouts, SLA alert sent. prepping a brief.

marta: root cause hypothesis: multiplex_http toggled long-lived connection behavior that exposed a latent gateway connection leak / insufficient pool tuning. regression introduced in feature flag rollout.

eli: collecting traces and flame graphs for the flag path. will attach to postmortem.

sanjay: next actions: 1) hot rollback (done) 2) postmortem with timeline + telemetry (eli) 3) change control: block multiplex_http rollout until gateway pool fix and load tests (marta) 4) customer comms draft (cs-lead + frank).

ops-bot: reminder: open incident ticket and tag SRE/Runtime/Platform.

marta: i've opened PR to gate the flag behind a bigger rollout + added a fatal check in deploy to prevent enabling multiplex on gateway clusters.

frank: customers notified with short summary and ETA for root cause (initial): "We observed a deploy-induced timeout regression affecting a subset of requests; we rolled back the change and are investigating. No ongoing customer impact."

incident-bot: incident closed (automatic) — marked as mitigated after rollback and stabilization.

sanjay: will follow up with a 72-hour postmortem. thanks everyone for fast response. :thumbsup:
